changelog:
- Initial release of Client Onboarding Automator.
- Automates end-to-end client onboarding: intake, contract, payment, welcome emails, and project setup.
- Processes inquiries via email or forms and updates your CRM with client details.
- Generates proposals, contracts, and Stripe payment links automatically.
- Sends a sequenced onboarding email series (day 0, 1, 3, 7) after payment.
- Sets up client project folders, tasks, and recurring reminders.
summary: Automates client onboarding from inquiry to project start, handling intake, contract creation, payment, welcome emails, and project setup.
